text:
Eloise Park: hey team! I'm Eloise — excited to join Redwood as a Site Reliability Engineer. I start today remote from Oakland. A few fun things about me: amateur urban beekeeper (yes, I actually keep bees and bring honey sometimes), terrible ukulele player, and I bake a mean cardamom cookie. Happy to pair on infra work or join the walking lunch crew. :wave:

Marco Li: welcome Eloise!! love the honey idea. where do you keep the bees? :honey_pot:

Mira Patel: hi Eloise 👋 welcome! pro cookie exchange? count me in. where's your desk? I can swing by with a plant.

Jun Park: Welcome!! badge should be active — facilities-bot just noted access granted. lunchtime strolls on Wednesdays if you want.

facilities-bot: Eloise Park's badge activated. Desk assigned: 3B-14. Welcome packet placed on desk.

Avery Tran: hi Eloise — our walking group meets at 12:30 by the kitchen. Are you team coffee or tea? poll: coffee / tea / coffee+cake

Sanaa Gupta: welcome! Honey swap sounds dangerous but delicious. :laughing:

Marco Li: (reaction: :thumbsup:) also, totally bring samples when you can — we unofficially rate honey on a 1-10 scale here ;)

Eloise Park: thanks all!! noted desk 3B-14. I'm more of a tea person but won't say no to cookie bribes. I'll bring a tiny jar next week and happy to pair on infra on Friday afternoon.

Mira Patel: yay! adding you to #sre-oncall and sending a calendar invite for the walking group. :sparkles:

facilities-bot: Welcome lunch scheduled for Eloise Park on Thursday 12:15pm at Kitchen A. RSVP options: yes / no / maybe

Avery Tran: RSVP yes. see you Thursday! :salute:
